content.json:
# Orders Processing Monitor
Real-time monitoring of order placement and processing through BackOffice service

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s == "orders" or ContainerName_s == "backoffice"
| where Log_s contains "Order"
| extend EventType = case(
    Log_s contains "placed", "OrderPlaced",
    Log_s contains "processed" or Log_s contains "Processed", "OrderProcessed",
    "Other"
  )
| where EventType != "Other"
| summarize Count=count() by EventType, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| render timechart
content.title: Orders: Placed vs Processed (Last Hour)

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s == "orders"
| where Log_s contains "placed"
| summarize OrdersPlaced=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| render barchart
content.title: Orders Service: Orders Placed Per 5 Minutes

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s == "backoffice"
| where Log_s contains "Order" and (Log_s contains "Received" or Log_s contains "processed" or Log_s contains "Sending")
| summarize count() by ContainerName_s, Log_s
| render table
content.title: BackOffice Service: Recent Activity

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s in ("orders", "backoffice")
| where Log_s contains "error" or Log_s contains "Error" or Log_s contains "failed" or Log_s contains "Failed"
| summarize ErrorCount=count() by ContainerName_s, TimeGenerated=bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Errors: Orders & BackOffice

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s == "orders" or ContainerName_s == "backoffice"
| where Log_s contains "wolverine" or Log_s contains "Wolverine"
| summarize count() by ContainerName_s, Log_s
| render table
content.title: Wolverine Messaging: Queue Operations

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s == "orders" or ContainerName_s == "backoffice"
| where Log_s contains "Order"
| extend OrderId = extract(@"Order[Id|id]?: ([a-f0-9\-]+)", 1, Log_s)
| where OrderId != ""
| summarize PlacedTime=min(TimeGenerated), ProcessedTime=max(TimeGenerated), EventCount=count() by OrderId, ContainerName_s
| project OrderId, PlacedTime, ProcessedTime, ProcessingDuration=ProcessedTime - PlacedTime, EventCount
| order by PlacedTime desc
| limit 20
content.title: Recent Orders: Processing Timeline
